articles.title: Trump Allows Red-Dyed Diesel as High Fuel Costs Hit Consumers
articles.description: Trump is allowing tax-free red-dyed diesel on highways as record fuel costs ripple through food, shipping, school buses and other everyday expenses.

articles.title: Ripple's David Schwartz Addresses Exchanges' Hesitation on Listing Bitcoin
articles.description: Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz suggests reasons why exchanges are holding back from listing a Bitcoin-split asset, while they had previously supported other Bitcoin forks.

articles.title: The Quebec election could result in a ripple, not a wave
articles.description: Province’s low-key election campaign has largely avoided conversations about separation, even though a significant number of ridings are in play

articles.title: Another Raid on XRP: Ripple Veteran David Schwartz Personally Exposes Fake Airdrop
articles.description: Ripple CTO David Schwartz drops GIFs on X to expose a fake Xaman wallet airdrop, halting an active phishing raid on XRP users.
